content.short: We aim to bring attention to the therapeutic potential of MDMA aka XTC with the help of NFTs.
content.description: MDMA‐assisted psychotherapy could be useful in the treatment of disorders associated with attachment insecurities, including PTSD, depression, anxiety disorders, obsessive‐compulsive disorder, suicidality, substance use disorders, and eating disorders. With piXelTC we want to bring attention to the topic and with a part of the raised funds we want to support researchers!
